errors.description: Model failed to understand that from the camera angle, each cube has three faces hidden (IN, LEFT, UP), not just one.
errors.evidence_quote: Model trace implies only one hidden face per cube, contradicting the ground truth which correctly identifies three hidden faces per cube (IN, LEFT, UP).

analysis_result.analysis: The model fundamentally misunderstood the spatial configuration of the cubes relative to the camera. Instead of recognizing that three faces per cube are hidden (IN, LEFT, UP), it assumed only one hidden face per cube. This led to a catastrophic counting error: instead of tallying 12 hidden faces (4 cubes × 3 faces), it only counted 4. Consequently, it misidentified yellow as the most frequent hidden color (2 occurrences) when purple actually appears 4 times among the correctly identified hidden faces. The error stems from both spatial misperception and flawed reasoning in aggregation.
